searchText: I am here to support the renaming of the fee variables! Proposal: - rename `base_fee` to `inclusion_fee` (or `inclusion_fee_per_gas`) because it’s the fee you pay for inclusion - rename `miner_tip` / `inclusion_fee` to `priority_fee` (or `priority_fee_per_gas`) because it’s the fee you pay to be ahead of everyone else I bring social proof to support my argument: https://twitter.com/thegostep/status/1382742730628071427?s=20 At flashbots, we've been working hard to educate miners on eip1559 and MEV - the "inclusion" vs "priority" dichotomy has been very useful in framing the recent drawdown in gas prices and arguing for how it would map to eip1559 source: https://medium.com/flashbots/flashbots-transparency-report-february-2021-8ac45b467d0a I think this new naming would clear up a lot of confusion in the community! A recent research post by Leo + Georgios uses a similar analogy of “high speed” and “low speed” highways https://www.aniccaresearch.tech/blog/ethereum-blockspace-who-gets-what-and-why I know everyone here is probably tired of discussing naming, but names matter! Picking names that intuitively make sense to the most amount of people helps people cooperate most efficiently. I hope it is not too late to consider the proposal Naming them 'base_fee' and 'priority_fee' implies that you don't have to pay _any_ 'priority_fee' for regular user transactions, which is not true at all. The priority fee serves two purposes, so it is unlikely we'll find something that perfectly fits. During times of no-congestion, priority fee determines position and has a minimum threshold required for inclusion. During times of increasing congestion, priority fee determines who gets in. Yep, I agree with you that gas stations should not have the responsibility on gas estimation for UX. I add that should be estimated correctly by consensus or wallets, that gas stations should be only for analytic purposes. We will see how 1559 performs on the wallets and hopefully have usable mainnet data. I see, perhaps base_fee and priority_fee would be more accurate as <@301186049323958275> suggested how about `insertion` instead of `priority`? If you pay a little bit, you get inserted in the block, if you pay a lot, you get inserted at the start of the block. But I guess "inclusion" has this connotation too <@!486501030046203915> have you seen this yet? https://github.com/louisoutin/eip1559_analysis

excerpts.content:
I am here to support the renaming of the fee variables! 

Proposal:
- rename `base_fee` to `inclusion_fee` (or `inclusion_fee_per_gas`) because it’s the fee you pay for inclusion 
- rename `miner_tip` / `inclusion_fee` to `priority_fee` (or `priority_fee_per_gas`) because it’s the fee you pay to be ahead of everyone else

I bring social proof to support my argument: https://twitter.com/thegostep/status/1382742730628071427?s=20

excerpts.author: thegostep
excerpts.content:
At flashbots, we've been working hard to educate miners on eip1559 and MEV - the "inclusion" vs "priority" dichotomy has been very useful in framing the recent drawdown in gas prices and arguing for how it would map to eip1559
source: https://medium.com/flashbots/flashbots-transparency-report-february-2021-8ac45b467d0a
